messages:
rachel: FYI — Sev ticket from customer VoltApps: sustained 504s/timeouts to hosted API since 08:14 UTC. Customer provided correlation id cid=ab12-3ef4. They see failures during bursts. Escalating to infra.

sam: On it. Can someone pull gateway traces and upstream logs for cid=ab12-3ef4? @infra-ci can you grab the graf/trace links?

infra-ci: alert: HTTP 504 spike on /v1/generate 08:14:12 -> 08:21:00 — ~72 504s, avg upstream latency ~28s. Top cause: upstream pod readiness delay / model-init. Trace: https://graf.redwood/trace/ab12-3ef4

morgan: Quick dump shows scale-up events fired but new pods stayed in ContainerCreating/CrashLoopReady for ~40–50s then never became Ready before gateway upstream timeout. Pasting snippets:

```
$ kubectl get hpa -n hosted -o wide
NAME   REFERENCE           TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
api    Deployment/api-svc  18%/80%   0         50        0
```

```
$ kubectl describe scaledobject api-burst -n hosted
Annotations:
  scaledobject.keda.sh/activation:           200
  scaledobject.keda.sh/pollingInterval:     30
  scaledobject.keda.sh/minReplicaCount:     0
```

morgan: So minReplicaCount=0 + activation threshold 200 reqs + pollingInterval 30s means cold path for bursty tenants. Also HPA target showed MINPODS=0 so coldstart is expected.

eva: Checked pod logs — model load for this tenant's model (quantized ~1.5GB) shows ~22s model-init. readinessProbe is default: initialDelaySeconds=10, periodSeconds=10, failureThreshold=3 -> pod only marked Ready ~30s after process starts + model-init => ~50–55s before Ready.

carla: Gateway upstream timeout is 30s for hosted endpoints, so full init+probe >> timeout => 504s. Customer saw spikes right after traffic bursts.

sam: Mitigation options: 1) increase gateway upstream timeout to 90s temporarily, 2) set scaledobject/HPA minReplicas=1 for this tenant, 3) reduce activation threshold or polling interval, 4) prewarm/persistent warm pool for high-tier customers.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: PATCH applied -> scaledobject/api-burst (minReplicaCount=1) by @sam at 08:38 UTC. Rolling update triggered.

rachel: Customer reports errors dropped after change and traffic stabilized. Good immediate fix. Need root cause & long-term.

morgan: Action items I will own: file INF-789 — add prewarm hooks, instrument model-init times in per-pod metrics, change default activation for hosted to 50 for bursty endpoints, and add guidance to onboarding docs about minReplica for low-latency tenants.

eva: Also propose we add a heuristic in routing: if tenant tier == paid && model-init > 15s then prefer dedicated/don't scale-to-zero by default.

sam: I'll follow up with a config PR to lower KEDA activation for text-generation routes and add a temporary gateway timeout override for product team to toggle per-tenant.

rachel: Thanks all. Closing for now — customer confirms resolution. Please reference INF-789 for follow-up. :thumbsup:
